name: 拉普拉斯边缘锐度
description: 分析 Laplacian edge response 分布 以检测 suppressed high-frequency edge detail characteristic of AI生成的 images.
mechanism: 应用 Laplacian kernel 以检测 edges and 测量 the 统计 分布 of edge responses. AI images often show suppressed high-frequency responses due to implicit smoothing in generation process.
parameters: Kernel: 3×3 Laplacian, Metrics: mean, 方差, kurtosis of |response|, 阈值: 自适应
source: Wang, Z. et al. (2004) — Image Quality Assessment, IEEE TIP; Marziliano, P. et al. (2002)
useCase: 检测AI内容中不自然的边缘锐度特征

references.title: Wang, Z. et al. (2004). Image Quality Assessment. IEEE TIP.

strengths:
• 快速计算
• 客观捕捉边缘质量
• 基于成熟的算子
• 良好的补充边缘信号
limitations:
• Sensitive to JPEG压缩
• Cannot distinguish AI from post-processing
• Image 分辨率 affects results
• Some AI models generate sharp edges
